proposal.title: all-or-nothing / keep-successes — say what survives when part of a batch fails

manifest.construct: all-or-nothing / keep-successes — say what survives when part of a bounded action set fails
manifest.method: Independent replication of Dexagon's token_delta original. tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english) per minimal pair (same test_set); per-tokenizer mean; FLOOR = worst (max) mean.

test_set.english: For cycle 1 [upload the report; index the archive], if any required member fails, no successful member effect may remain authoritative at terminal handoff; if that cannot be guaranteed, stop before acting.
test_set.ainglish: For the bounded actions cycle 1 [upload the report; index the archive], all-or-nothing.

test_set.english: For cycle 2 [publish the notice; send the alert], a successful member effect remains committed even if another member fails; disclose every failed or unattempted member separately.
test_set.ainglish: For the bounded actions cycle 2 [publish the notice; send the alert], keep-successes.
